method.format_note: Matches the repo v0.3 LLM-native program-level contract; this file is the llm_native_v0_2 clean-room variant.
method.workflow: Clean-room official-site reading from allowed repo docs, KLU crawler v0.3/v0.4 candidate JSON, embedded source evidence, and official KLU pages only. Crawler output was treated as recall candidate data and obvious shared-FAQ/template noise was not imported as fact.
limitations: No LLM v0.1 answer file was opened or compared.

The KLU crawler evidence frequently merges undergraduate, graduate, PhD, and shared FAQ requirements; v0.2 keeps only program-level facts that are visible in official KLU pages or explicit candidate evidence.
English-test alternatives are shared requirements and may differ by level; program records keep conservative B2/proof-of-English language where the official programme page only states B2.
Some current official page content was live-read, but no login/application portal was used.

key_findings: KLU v0.4 recovered eight official programme/pathway URLs, compared with one noisy v0.3 crawler programme record.
v0.2 normalizes page-title programme names into stable programme names and separates Hamburg/Saigon Global Logistics tracks because admissions evidence and campus differ.
Shared KLU FAQ language-test alternatives are kept as shared/candidate evidence, while programme pages with only English B2 keep that conservative requirement.
The MBA record keeps GMAT as conditional/alternative and preserves the 3-year work-experience requirement.
